defs.def: to remove sth that has been written or printed, or that has been stored on a computer 删去；删除noun

ex.s: Discuss with a partner: Which relative pronouns can be deleted in your sentences?
ex.t: 与同伴讨论：你的句子中哪些关系代词可以被省略（删除）？

ex.s: However, there is no “magic pill” or delete button that will help you; you have to think about your bad habits and decide on some changes.
ex.t: 然而，没有什么＂灵丹妙药＂或删除按钮能帮你；你必须思考自己的坏习惯并决定做出一些改变。

ex.s: Then delete some of the phrases to make the sentences shorter and see how the meanings have changed.
ex.t: 然后删除一些短语，让句子更短，看看意思如何变化。

ex.s: Fill in the blanks with the correct forms of the words in the box below delete arise pace examine abnormal adjust restore restrict 1 Please have faith in this treatment.
ex.t: 用方框中单词的正确形式填空：delete 删除、arise 出现、pace 节奏、examine 检查、abnormal 异常、adjust 调整、restore 恢复、restrict 限制。1 请相信这种治疗。
